name: lands
description: Stage 2 land ownership: flattened PAD-US Fee ownership fill (land_fee) + wilderness/WSA motorized-closure overlay (land_overlay), one PMTiles tileset.

land_fee.mgr: normalized manager code: BLM|USFS|NPS|FWS|BOR|FED_OTHER|DOD|TRIBAL|ST_PARK|ST_WILDLIFE|ST_TRUST|ST_FOREST|ST_OTHER|LOCAL|NGO — PVT/UNK are DROPPED (unshaded = private, the atlas convention)
land_fee.access: PAD-US Pub_Access: OA|RA|XA (UK dropped — never render unknown as a confident claim)

schema.contract_note: This schema is the CONTRACT with the Android client (LandTileFeatureParser + LayerRegistry.LANDS_FILL_COLORS). Change both sides together or neither.

padus_fee.what: USGS PAD-US 4.1 Fee layer — THE flattened ownership base (already integrates BLM SMA, USFS, NPS LRD, FWS realty, DOD, Census tribal, state stewards)
padus_fee.fetch: https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/file/get/{item}?name={filename} — VERIFIED WORKING with a browser User-Agent (the manager/download and manager file URLs return the SPA HTML shell; catalog/file/get streams the zip)
padus_fee.license: US Government public domain; USGS GAP citation requested
padus_fee.gotcha: NEVER read the Proclamation layer as ownership (admin extents contain private land). Fee only.

padus_designation.what: PAD-US Designation layer, Des_Tp IN (WA, WSA) → wilderness/wsa overlay fallback (always available, same GDB)
padus_designation.gotcha: Designation polygons OVERLAP Fee by design — they feed ONLY land_overlay, never the fee fill.

wilderness_connect.role: overlay-patch (fresher than PAD-US Designation for new designations)
wilderness_connect.status: adapter slot — not yet wired; PAD-US Designation serves until then

usfs_basic_ownership.what: S_USA.BasicOwnership — actual USFS-owned surface; fixes private-inholding staleness inside forests
usfs_basic_ownership.filter: OWNERCLASSIFICATION = 'USDA FOREST SERVICE' only — non-FS rows are the inholdings and must NOT paint green

ut_ugrc_sgid.role: patch (UT wholesale — best statewide ownership layer in the country)

fws_realty.role: patch slot (Realty boundaries, NEVER Approved Acquisition)

state_trust_az_nm_mt_co.role: patch slots (AZ needs written OK — non-commercial clause; PAD-US fallback until then)

precedence: agency patches > BLM SMA > PAD-US base. Merge is geometric (higher priority carves lower) because fee fills are translucent — overlapping same-layer polygons double-blend into dark artifacts.

qa.acreage: per-manager normalized output within 2% of raw PAD-US GIS_Acres sums (qa_lands.py)
qa.private_probes: known private-inholding points must have NO public fee polygon (qa_lands.py --probes)
qa.visual: MANUAL GATE: side-by-side vs protectedlands.net on 10 checkerboard areas (Crow MT, UT trust sections, Telluride CO inholdings)
